questions.stem: A course grade is based 40% on a score of 80 and 60% on a score of 92. What is the resulting grade?
questions.explanation: Compute the weighted sum: 0.4(80) + 0.6(92) = 87.2.

questions.stem: What is the arithmetic mean of 5, 8, 10, 9, 8?
questions.explanation: The sum is 40, and dividing by 5 gives 8.

questions.stem: What is the median of the data set 2, 5, 6, 8, 10, 13, 17, 20?
questions.explanation: After ordering the data, the middle value or mean of the two middle values is 9.

questions.stem: A course grade is based 25% on a score of 74 and 75% on a score of 90. What is the resulting grade?
questions.explanation: Compute the weighted sum: 0.25(74) + 0.75(90) = 86.
